item.title: Introduction to Access Controls in Swift
item.description: In Swift language, Access Controls are features that restricts access over your code and module. You can specify them over classes, structs, modules and variables. There are 5 different Access Level currently and let’s check out how to use them? Open Access In Swift world, you must heard about modules, I mean not the folder represented modules like in a single Xcode application. I mean the module is that may 3rd party library from Cocoapods, Swift Package Manager or Carthage.
